stages.title: Story playthrough + the missable
stages.summary: Play the five story chapters at your own pace. Take optional missions as they appear, scan new vehicles and study new animals as you go, and do Lucia's balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends.
tasks: Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: accept Lucia's meditation on the balcony of Jason's house (the only potentially missable step).
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter: 15 manual slots, no mission replay.
Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study every new animal with binoculars from Chapter 1 on.
Accept the side questlines as they unlock: Kenton (Ch1), Billy and Bret (after Coffee Break), Andy, Randy and Tyrone (Ch3).
Do not use cheats: they switch off trophies and saving for the session.

stages.title: Collectibles cleanup
stages.summary: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the exploration lists: meditations, card sets, WAiNK scans and unfogging the map. Only some of each list is needed.
tasks: Meditate at all 18 spots (trophy) – the 100% list only needs 15.
Complete 3 collectible card sets (trophy) – 100% needs 15 of 18.
WAiNK 100 locations; unfog the whole map by plane.
100% extras: 33/33 underwater discoveries, 100/125 Cocaine Flamingos, 30/34 magazines, 5/7 Kenton treasure sets.

stages.title: Activities, robberies & challenges
stages.summary: Gold every shooting range, clear the drone courses, win races, finish the stunts and robberies, and complete 70 of the 80 challenges for 100%.
tasks: Shooting ranges: all 42 gold medals. Drone Time Trials: all 42 at 14 Top Fun locations.
Races: 20 different wins for the trophy, 30 of 40 for 100%. Stunts: 250 for the trophy, 300 for 100%.
Robberies: all 39 gang operations, 8 bank vaults, 22 bank jobs, 7 Payday Loans.
Challenges: 50 for the trophy, 70 of 80 for 100% – skip the 10 hardest.

stages.title: Final grind & one-offs
stages.summary: Close out A Long Road, the eight Strangers & Freaks strands (not part of 100%) and the one-off hidden trophies, then the platinum pops.
tasks: Finish the 100% Completion checklist (A Long Road).
Tick off one-offs: airliner theft, tank, showroom Banshee, UFO, rooftop cocktail, Ten Pin.
Spend-and-buy trophies: all 8 garages, 10 registered vehicles, $100,000 in shops.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum arrives on its own once the other 54 are earned. Everything on the list is single-player: there are no online trophies, no DLC trophies and no difficulty setting, and one playthrough is enough because free roam carries on after the credits. Both roadmaps put the platinum at roughly 200 hours and 4/10 difficulty; most of that time goes into the 100% checklist, not the story.
steps: Stage 1: play the story, do the Chapter 1 meditation, keep chapter saves.
Stages 2–3: work the 100% checklist in free roam.
Stage 4: Strangers & Freaks and the one-off trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Comes with the end of the first main mission of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed. Use the moment to set the game up for the platinum: both roadmaps suggest switching on every progress and collectible HUD notification and starting a rotation of manual saves, because the game has no mission replay.
steps: Finish Gone Fishing.
Settings > UI: turn on progress, collectible and criminal profile notifications.
Make your first manual save.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The longest trophy, but not a true 100%: PowerPyx estimates the checklist at about 60% of the game. It becomes visible after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, story progress already counts, and nothing on it is missable. KeenGamer's tables give the targets: 100 optional tasks; all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 Payday Loans and 8 vaults; 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33/33 underwater finds, 100/125 Cocaine Flamingos; 200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals, 50/66 weapons; 30/40 races, 42/42 range golds, 42/42 drone trials, 300 stunts, 70/80 challenges and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
steps: Take optional missions as they appear (100 needed; meditating with both partners counts twice).
Scan vehicles and study animals from Chapter 1.
After the credits, work the checklist list by list, stopping at each target.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any mix of the 397 stunts counts: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. PowerPyx finds Under the Bridges the quickest. Doing a stunt once is enough; the optional challenges on its map icon are not needed. Carry on to 300, the figure the 100% checklist asks for.
steps: Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots lists found and finished stunts by name.
Progress > Activities > Stunts shows totals per region.
Fly under bridges for quick numbers, then mop up jumps.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball hoops, a video game, a win in a car race, race challenge or drone race, and a stunt. The story introduces most of them, and the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell) shows the rest. Touchpad > Progress > Activities shows which you have done.
steps: Check Progress > Activities for the missing type.
Do one of it; most come naturally with the 100% list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 range challenges spread over 12 Shooting Range locations, and every one needs gold; the 100% checklist asks for the same 42. The pages opened for this guide give the counts but no per-challenge tactics (PowerPyx links a separate location guide). Ranges also raise your Focus stat, which helps with Gunslinger.
steps: Visit all 12 ranges and play each challenge.
Replay any silver or bronze until gold.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only. During Chapter 3 Andy phones Lucia and then texts an address in Belville, which marks the strand. Five quests follow, from Climbing the Cellerichain through Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, and Read the Label; the trophy comes with the last one, Puff Puff Pass. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton calls a while after Island Dreams and appears as a green KR icon in Key Lento. His quests are treasure dives: he marks purple chest icons, you dive to the wreck, dig the loot up with the metal detector and bring it back. Seven shipwrecks in all finish the strand. He goes silent after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again in Chapter 2 or 3 (calling Brian later in Chapter 2 speeds this up), so the trophy is not missable. 100% only needs 5 of his 7 treasure sets.
steps: Take Kenton's call after Island Dreams.
Dive the marked wrecks and hand in each set.
Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County once Coffee Break is done. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and the finale Hometown Heroes, which awards the trophy. It is still there after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only some side strands count as strangers. The named character questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others) do not. PowerPyx confirms four that do: Kirk (Skunk Ape and Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries); it says the rest of the list is still being found, so check the trophy's tracker as you finish each one. Strangers are not part of 100% and all remain after the story, which makes this a stage-4 cleanup job.
steps: Finish Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Pick up other open-world strangers and watch the tracker climb to 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.unlock: After Chapter 3 – Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Key Cloner mission: 16 sports cars, the first (the Zorrusso) delivered inside the story mission. Scan high-end cars with WAiNK to see if he wants them; a wanted car prompts a delivery to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Better condition pays more. PowerPyx finds them most often parked by hotels in Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. The list lives under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Scan and steal the 15 remaining cars.
Deliver each to Randy undamaged.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.unlock: After Chapter 3 – Here, Kitty Kitty (Jason only)
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only and opens after Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show synthetic drug labs around Vice City: destroy them for Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough are gone, Tyrone gives Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy. Available after the story too.
steps: As Jason, destroy the marked labs.
Take Tyrone's follow-up, Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house is gone after Chapter 1. Unconfirmed if required – do it anyway.
trophies.guide: 18 spots in 10 places; Jason and Lucia can each meditate at one, so a place can count twice. The risk is the first: after Chapter 1's Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen one morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It raises the counter but isn't marked as a spot, and neither source confirms the trophy needs it (PowerPyx had done it when it popped) – so do it. The last spot needs both partners, after Coffee Break. 100% needs only 15.
steps: Chapter 1, morning after Down to Earth: follow Lucia to the balcony, accept.
Save before leaving Chapter 1.
Later, meditate at every marked spot (Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel texts Jason (not Lucia) after Coffee Break and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He then asks for specific animals at purple hunting spots; he also gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle, collected from any Ammu-Nation locker. Clean one-shot kills pay more but are optional. Which animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed, but 100% needs all 15 Target Decks (Map > Activities > Target Deck), so finishing those covers it.
steps: As Jason, do Veteran Hunted.
Work through Bret's 15 Target Decks.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK spots are scannable things in the world: PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures plus No Flusher tags, more than 100 in all, and any 100 count. Hold the WAiNK shortcut and scan whenever a prompt appears; 100% asks for the same 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: 80 challenges exist; 50 earn the trophy and 70 are needed for 100%, so you can skip the ten worst. Many tick off while you do other things, so leave this until late, then open Progress > Challenges and pick the quickest unfinished ones (the completed check mark sits bottom-right on each).
steps: Ignore it until the late game.
Review Progress > Challenges and clear the easiest.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once Coffee Break lets you roam with your partner (hold the partner button to call them). Raise the wanted level to four stars, then flee on a fast sports bike; PowerPyx's favourite escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cars struggle to follow and the helicopter loses sight. It pops only after you leave the red heat zone, not the flashing search area. Bank vault robberies (Chapter 4 optional) give four stars automatically, so it often comes by itself.
steps: Call your partner.
Get 4 stars, escape by bike through the Ambrosia rail tunnel.
Leave the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.unlock: After Coffee Break; easiest after Ch3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs
trophies.guide: With your partner along, hit three robbery targets in a row while the police chase never ends – keep the flashing wanted level, not just the red heat. PowerPyx suggests the three jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): grab several items in each and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. Bring armour and healing. The trophy is delayed about half a minute after the third shop; if it doesn't come, rob a fourth.
steps: Buy armour and sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation.
Call your partner, rob the 3 north Vice City jewelers back-to-back.
Wait ~30 s after the third; hit a fourth if needed.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app discovers it; you never need to drive it. Stand by a busy road and scan everything new that passes, plus boats and aircraft when you see them. 557 vehicles exist at launch and 100% wants 200 of the 277 base models, so this bronze arrives on the way. Totals are under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
steps: Hold the WAiNK shortcut and scan new vehicles.
Check Progress > Vehicles for totals.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time while you aim and drains the purple bar under health and stamina. Top the bar up first (food, drinks, a shower or face wash at home) and use Adrenaline to stretch it. PowerPyx's setup: body armour, an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556, and a gang operation where five criminals stand close together; it reports police, soldiers and civilians don't seem to count. Focus levels up to 4 from ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late.
steps: Fill Focus; take Adrenaline.
At a gang operation, trigger Combat Focus and drop 5 criminals.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner that is docked at a passenger boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport – planes parked out on the airfield don't count. PowerPyx recommends the one at departure gates E3/E4: break through the perimeter fence, take the stairs beside the bridge to the door, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse out, take off, and fly about 1 km (0.6 mi) away until it pops.
steps: Ram through the VCIA fence to gates E3/E4.
Board via the stairs, reverse, take off.
Fly 1 km from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank. They are parked in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island base at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Crash the gate (or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and fire on a few enemies until the trophy appears.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, Mariana County.
Enter a tank in the south of the base and fight briefly.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies (green icons). Pick the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it, find the note with the safe code in the back room, empty the safe, and – the part people miss – destroy the security footage and switch off the alarm there too. The trophy follows soon after you leave. PowerPyx used Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
steps: Snap Gun the back door.
Open the safe with the code note.
Destroy the footage, disable the alarm, leave unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.unlock: Chapter 4 optional – That's Where The Money Is…
trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 optional mission teaches vault jobs: tail a security van to a bank, slip into the vault while the guard has it open, and pass one bag to your partner because you can't carry everything. Afterwards Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 (after his two Payday Loans jobs). Each vault gives four stars at once; a fast bike and a vehicle swap shake the police. Any 5 of the 8 vaults earn the silver, all 8 are needed for 100%, and each can pay up to $205,000.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is….
Buy van tips from Yasmani, follow vans to banks.
Rob and escape five times (eight for 100%).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.unlock: Chapter 4 optional – That's Where The Money Is…
trophies.guide: PowerPyx says robbing a large bank vault counts as an armored truck job, so the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… grants it. To get it sooner, block an armored truck near a Vice City bank, stick a sticky bomb on its rear doors, grab the cash and escape the red heat zone or use a Pay 'n' Spray. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once his jobs are done.
steps: Either play the Chapter 4 vault intro,
or sticky-bomb a truck's back door and escape the heat.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear every patch of black fog from the map. A plane is the fastest way: fly lines across whatever is still dark on the map until none is left. The kit's list tracks 52 areas.
steps: Get a plane.
Sweep the fogged areas until the map is fully revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run 39 illegal operations (yellow map icons, many marked by the story). One of each gang's earns the trophy; 100% wants all 39, so it comes along the way. Progress > Gangs shows, per gang, how many you have hit.
steps: Open Progress > Gangs to see which gang is missing.
Rob one operation of that gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx's method: at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, order an Apple Martini and drink it while standing at the bar. KeenGamer still marks the exact trigger as unconfirmed, so if it doesn't pop, try again in a different spot along the bar.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it at the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.unlock: After Chapter 3 – Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Key Cloner)
trophies.guide: Only one car works: the blue Banshee in the showroom in the south of Vice City, a nod to the GTA III Banshee per PowerPyx. Once the Key Cloner is yours (Chapter 3), hack the car, drive straight through the showroom window and keep going; the trophy is slightly delayed. KeenGamer lists the method as unconfirmed.
steps: Get the Key Cloner (Chapter 3).
Clone the blue Banshee and drive through the window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation you first visit in Chapter 2's optional Hit Kingpin Bowling. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east corner table, and the safe in the office off the north-east hallway (code 0300, or sticky bombs). The trophy comes once you lose the police. Not missable: miss an item and the operation respawns later; earlier pickups still count.
steps: Grab the watch (SE office) and the shotgun (NE table).
Open the NE hallway office safe: 0300.
Escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Both sources tie it to maxing the Strength stat on Jason and Lucia at the same time (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength, heart icon). Buy a gym membership and always bring your partner: while you work out, the other trains alongside, doubling progress. Gyms show under Map > Activities; after the story you can also train at home.
steps: Call your partner and go to a gym together.
Train until both Strength bars are full.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Counts 500 actions that move your criminal profile – stealthy jobs, non-lethal takedowns, kills, clean escapes all count. Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile to see each one, and check the count on the trophy itself. It usually finishes passively during robberies. Stay out of the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent and makes police much more aggressive.
steps: Enable Criminal Profile notifications.
Let robberies and fights fill the 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: PowerPyx: return as Lucia, alone, to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City – the store from the prologue – once Credit Check has unlocked Payday Loans jobs. Deal with the guards, empty the three cash drawers and get away on foot, not in a car; it pops after you leave the search area. KeenGamer still lists the method as unconfirmed.

Escape on foot.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: PowerPyx's UFO easter egg: alone, after 2 AM, on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, look for a car with blinking lights at the roadside (it doesn't always spawn – leave and return). Follow the path into the woods toward the blue light; the UFO drops a woman. Offer help and take her back to her car. KeenGamer lists it as unconfirmed.
steps: Come solo after 2 AM, NW of the Starlet Motel.
Find the blinking car, follow the path to the UFO.
Help the woman back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds. Crowded streets in Vice City or the Ocean Beach strip make the count easy. KeenGamer says the precise rule is still being confirmed.
steps: Get a bike in a crowded area.
Kick 10 pedestrians inside a minute.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.unlock: After Chapter 3 – Credit Check (Dye Pack Jammer)
trophies.guide: Credit Check gives you the Dye Pack Jammer, which lets you launder marked bills. Rob banks and Payday Loans and sell the bills to a fence – Yasmani in Vice City pays best. The $250,000 is cumulative, and 100% needs the same $250,000 of marked bills fenced. Bank vaults (Chapter 4 optional) pay up to $205,000 a job, so a couple finish it.
steps: Rob banks, Payday Loans and later vaults.
Fence the marked bills with Yasmani until $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spending adds up across every shop type: mod shops, Pay 'n' Sprays, Ammu-Nations, clothing, footwear, salons, tattoo studios and electronics. Guns, car mods and tattoos cost the most, so they finish it fastest. Leave it for when vault money is rolling in.
steps: Buy weapons and car mods with robbery money.
Top up with tattoos.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Eight garages are for sale (the four story garages don't count), costing $160,000 together. After Daily Driver the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone and you buy them there. Robberies in Chapters 3–4 pay for it quickly. Buying garages also adds the parking spots On the Spot needs.
steps: Open the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 garages ($160,000).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives with the Chapter 2 mission Moses and lets you call registered cars to you. You need parking first: each garage you buy (see Little Boxes) adds spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 cars with Standard Trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so cheap cars and bikes keep it low.
steps: Buy garages for parking spots.
Respray and register 10 cheap stolen cars at Moses or a Pay 'n' Spray.
